text.tspan: Apple APNs
Your relay
Official relay
Your phone
Apple APNs
Your relay
Official relay
Your phone
Phase 1 - the phone mints its own keys
the X25519 private key stays in the phone keychain
Phase 2 - pairing with a relay
the ticket cannot be replayed against another phone
stores the APNs token, the device key
and the public key only
Phase 3 - sending a push - the same steps on either relay
the managed signer forwards only an opaque envelope
the APNs .p8 never leaves this host
[hosted relay (no self-hosting)]
Phase 4 - the gateway, if you deploy one
the Ed25519 private key stays on the gateway
What never crosses the wire:
X25519 private key - stays in the phone keychain
APNs .p8 private key - stays on your relay
Ed25519 private key - stays on your gateway
pairing ticket - single use and short lived

svg.text: generate the device key (random, per installation)
generate the X25519 identity (curve25519 key pair)
decrypt if the envelope is encrypted
verify with the Ed25519 public key
